data.name: RemoveParameter_NoParameter
data.value: There is no parameter here to remove.

data.name: RemoveParameter_NotDeclaredByWorkspace
data.value: '{0}' is not declared by the workspace: only what the workspace declares can be changed.

data.name: RemoveParameter_Used
data.value: '{0}' is used at {2}: without the parameter, that name would refer to nothing.

data.name: RemoveParameter_ParamArray
data.value: '{0}' is a ParamArray: removing it is not supported.

data.name: RemoveParameter_Value
data.value: '{0}' is the value that '{1}' assigns: a Property Let or Property Set always takes it.

data.name: RemoveParameter_Event
data.value: '{0}' is a parameter of the event '{1}': removing the parameter of an event is not supported.

data.name: RemoveParameter_Handler
data.value: '{0}' handles an event, and takes the parameters of the event: it keeps them.

data.name: RemoveParameter_ExternalProcedure
data.value: '{0}' is a parameter of '{1}', which its library declares: it cannot be removed.

data.name: RemoveParameter_Evaluated
data.value: The argument passed for '{0}' at {2} does more than read a value: removing it would change what the code does.

data.name: RemoveParameter_LateBound
data.value: '{1}' may be called late-bound at {2}: the argument passed there for '{0}' would not be removed.

data.name: RemoveParameter_CalledByName
data.value: '{1}' is called by its name in a string at {2}: the argument passed there for '{0}' would not be removed.

data.name: RemoveParameter_Unresolved
data.value: What '{0}' refers to at {2} is not known: the change could miss it.

data.name: RemoveParameter_UnknownDocumentHost
data.value: '{0}' is a procedure of a document module whose host is not known: what the host calls it for, and with which arguments, is not known.
